messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate detected for service `inference-api` in eu-west-1. 10m avg = 22% 5xx. Auto-page oncall@sre.
sara (oncall): ack'ing. grabbing dashboards and recent deploy events.
ben (infra): canary replicas are CrashLoopBackOffing. lots of restarts and then HPA scales back down to zero. tagging @liz for the recent deploy.
liz (deploy): i pushed a canary via helm earlier at 1954344800 (chart bump + configmap tweak). which pods are failing?
alex (sre): here are the logs from a dying container:
alex (sre): ```
$ kubectl logs inference-api-canary-0 -n prod-canary
FATAL: missing required env DB_URL
panic: exit status 1
...
```
ben (infra): that points to a configmap change in the canary that removed DB_URL reference — the app exits immediately, startupProbe fails, kube restarts. with HPA minReplicas=0 the canary quickly goes to 0 and traffic flips awkwardly.
liz (deploy): i did change the configmap key name in the chart to `database_url` and updated the template, but the image expects `DB_URL`. our templating missed an alias. my bad.
sara (oncall): customer impact?
maria (support): seeing a spike of 502/503 errors from multiple customers starting 00:18 UTC. some dashboards show downstream retries, increased latency. tickets from two enterprise customers escalated.
release-bot: Helm release `inference-api` canary revision 12 deployed by liz at 1954344800; strategy: 15% canary.
alex (sre): additional complication: a couple of nodes were under maintenance (cordoned) and PDB is preventing eviction, so scheduler couldn't place new healthy pods quickly. combined with HPA=0 we had a gap.
ben (infra): mitigation plan: 1) patch HPA minReplicas to 1 for the canary so at least one pod remains for debugging and doesn't scale to zero; 2) revert configmap to previous version or rollback the helm release; 3) if needed, flip FF routing to avoid canary.
ben (infra): applying temporary HPA change:
ben (infra): ```
kubectl patch hpa inference-api -n prod-canary -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":1}}'
```
liz (deploy): i'll trigger a rollback to the prior helm revision while preparing a corrected configmap. rolling back helm to rev 11 now: `helm rollback inference-api 11 -n prod-canary`
liz (deploy): also creating a corrective patch for the configmap with DB_URL set back.
release-bot: Feature flag router: canary route still active. Consider toggling to send 100% to stable while we recover.
sara (oncall): do the rollback + flip feature flag. we want traffic off canary ASAP.
liz (deploy): flipping feature flag `canary_inference_route` -> false via ff-service: `curl -sS -X POST https://ff.internal/toggle -d '{"key":"canary_inference_route","value":false}'` -> 200 OK
release-bot: Feature flag `canary_inference_route` toggled to false by liz at 1954345205
alex (sre): checking pod status after rollback and HPA patch:
alex (sre): ```
$ kubectl get pods -n prod -l app=inference-api
NAME                                  READY   STATUS      RESTARTS   AGE
inference-api-11ab2d-0                 1/1     Running     0          6m
inference-api-11ab2d-1                 1/1     Running     0          6m
inference-api-canary-0                 0/1     CrashLoop   7          12m
```
alex (sre): stable replicas are healthy, canary pod still crashing but not receiving traffic.
maria (support): drafting customer update: note rollback performed, investigating root cause, monitoring. will send to impacted customers in 10m.
sara (oncall): metrics check — are 5xx rates dropping?
ben (infra): 5xx back down from 22% -> 1.1% in the last 5m after rollout flip and rollback. latency steady.
liz (deploy): root cause summary: configmap key rename in chart (`DB_URL` -> `database_url`) without updating app or providing env alias. surfaced only in canary because stable chart still had correct key. bad validation in templating pipeline.
alex (sre): secondary contributors: HPA minReplicas set to 0 allowed canary to fully scale down, PDBs + cordoned nodes delayed replacement scheduling, increasing error window.
sara (oncall): immediate action items: 1) enforce configmap key validation in CI for canary charts, 2) default HPA minReplicas=1 for critical services in prod-canary namespaces, 3) add a pre-rollout check that ensures feature-flag routing isn't pointing 100% at a new canary during config changes.
liz (deploy): creating follow-up tickets: #4601 add configmap key linting in chart-ci, #4602 HPA defaults for critical services, #4603 rollback playbook update to include FF kill-switch steps.
ben (infra): i'll also add a guard in the rollout controller: if canary pods crash >5 times in 10m, automatically pause and reroute traffic to stable.
release-bot: Incident flagged as mitigated by sara at 1954347000
maria (support): support queue trending down. sending final customer note that issue has been mitigated and were performing a postmortem.
sara (oncall): handing monitoring to alex for the next 45m then will run blameless postmortem. leaving incident board notes: https://incidents.redwood/1954345000
alex (sre): ack, will monitor logs and confirm no regressions for 1h.
sara (oncall): thanks team :thumbsup:
